Map libraries served by the app itself (app/_map_assets.py), so the maps never
wait on an outside CDN. The files are the exact releases the maps loaded from
their CDNs before, unmodified.

leaflet/            Leaflet 1.9.3
                    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/leaflet@1.9.3/dist/
                    BSD 2-Clause License
                    (c) 2010-2022 Vladimir Agafonkin, (c) 2010-2011 CloudMade

leaflet.draw/       Leaflet.draw 1.0.2
                    https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/leaflet.draw/1.0.2/
                    MIT License
                    (c) 2012-2017, Jacob Toye, Jon West, Smartrak, Leaflet

protomaps/          protomaps-leaflet 5.1.0  (dist/protomaps-leaflet.js)
                    https://www.npmjs.com/package/protomaps-leaflet
                    BSD 3-Clause License, (c) Protomaps LLC
                    pmtiles 4.5.0  (dist/pmtiles.js)
                    https://www.npmjs.com/package/pmtiles
                    BSD 3-Clause License, (c) Protomaps LLC
                    They draw the Sites map's offline basemap from the local
                    map packs (rfopt/geo/offline_basemap.py).

Offline map imagery (not shipped with the app; fetched by the user's
"Update offline map" into the local pack folder, rfopt/geo/offline_basemap.py):
                    NASA Black Marble / Blue Marble (NASA GIBS) - public domain
                    Sentinel-2 cloudless 2016 by EOX IT Services GmbH
                    (modified Copernicus Sentinel data) - CC BY 4.0
                    Esri World Imagery - Imagery (c) Esri, Maxar, Earthstar
                    Geographics; fetched with the user's own ArcGIS API key
                    and used under that account's Esri terms of use
